# Spuro 0.3.0

Improves offline UNKNOWN reconciliation and introduces verified release packaging.

- Distinguish repeated schema sightings and inherited fork/event/fragment copies
  from independent later activity, using bounded provenance and identity checks.
- Accept exact interrupted-turn controls, scoped user revert evidence, stash
  third-parent blob witnesses, and versioned bounded-user/tracker-merge evidence
  as advisory inspection leads. Preserve lifecycle states and coverage gaps.
- Raise the minimum Go version to 1.26.8, matching the supported CI toolchain.
- Adopt signed-tag release preflight, source and compiled-binary vulnerability
  gates, native-target smoke tests, CycloneDX module/stdlib inventory, build
  receipts, and verification of the complete downloaded artifact set.

Spuro remains read-only. No provider execution/refresh, live completion queries,
cleanup, rescue refs, fetching, semantic completion or session resumption is added.
Offline leads are not proof of historic completion. Private Windows acceptance
and cross-machine coverage remain bounded by the evidence described in
[verified maturity](https://github.com/MTG-Thomas/spuro/blob/v0.3.0/docs/maturity.md).

Archives contain Spuro, both optional analyzer adapters, README, AGPL-3.0-only
LICENSE and BUILD.json for Linux/macOS/Windows on amd64/arm64. Companion receipts
record source/compiler/target and binary digests. Cross-compiled targets explicitly
report runtime_smoke:false. Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS; receipts and the
module/stdlib SBOM establish consistency, not independent signing/attestation or
exhaustive platform validation.

Native Git is required for estate/session scans; offline reconciliation needs no
Git/provider executable. Existing v0.2.0 assets are unchanged.
